figures.caption: Fig. 2. Qualitative comparison of HOI reconstruction. C2Dex produces more plausible hand–object configurations with more stable contacts and less hand–object penetration than the competing methods.
Fig. 3. Qualitative comparison of retargeting accuracy. C2Dex better retains task-relevant contacts while producing substantially less hand–object penetration.

Fig. 4. Representative real-world trajectory replay results on four contact-rich tasks: Hang Cap, Sweep Litter, Wipe Board, and Drop Litter. For each task, the upper row shows the human demonstration and the lower row shows the corresponding dexterous-hand execution generated by C2Dex.

Fig. 1. Overview of C2Dex. Given a monocular human video, C2Dex first performs contact-consistent HOI reconstruction by aggregating frame-wise contact observations into stable object-side contacts, and then transfers the reconstructed interaction to a dexterous hand through contact-interactionpreserving retargeting with stable-contact preservation, Laplacian interaction optimization, and residual reinforcement learning.
